findings.issue: Button.url is stored without scheme validation in this task. This is intentional and in-scope-deferred: strict http(s) URI validation (anti scheme-injection / SSRF, Decision 10) lives in Task 4 (validateSteps), and no server-side request is made with this URL anywhere in Task 1. The field is a pure model holder.
findings.suggestion: No action in Task 1. Ensure Task 4 enforces the strict URI scheme/host check before activation.

findings.issue: Step ids are minted with new ObjectId().toHexString(), which is partially predictable (timestamp + counter). This is acceptable: step ids are not authorization tokens. The anti-IDOR control for callbacks (Decision 6) is enforced at the advanceOnCallback/resumeOnCallback layer (Task 5) by scoping the CAS to subscriberId/projectId, not by id unguessability.
findings.suggestion: No action. Predictability of step ids is a non-issue given the server-side ownership check planned for Task 5.
